validation: One unwrapped first development cell, one wrapped repeat of its main capture. Both count against the bound.

shape.padding: local tokenization of literal x; fixed before outputs
shape.readout: original prompt end; never after dummy suffix

capture: Embedding, all 28 outgoing residuals and all attention/MLP writes at every sentence/question token and original prompt-end position. Native sequential operations. Float32 copies of native captured values. Full-vocabulary logits retained.
competence: Full-vocabulary argmax belongs to gold Yes/No alias class AND deduplicated class logsumexp gold margin >0. All 16 checks required per family. No model-specific edits.
held_out_gate: At least one fully competent development family, validation pass and causal-prefix pass. Component reconstruction failure suppresses component claims but does not alter valid residual observations. No held-out inference if gate fails.
annotation_gate: Human pass on the 16-sentence review document, or explicit human waiver recorded as AI-only annotation limitation. Never inferred from silence.
primary_analysis: Every layer/token interaction I=(across_swap-across_original)-(within_swap-within_original), raw response norms and direction relationships. Exact pre-cue null, question-prefix null, whole-map individual-family reporting. Undefined ratios/cosines are undefined, not zero.
descriptive_summaries: Whole-block unweighted mean normalized interaction at sentence-period and original prompt-end, final interaction norm, all-layer labeled response Grams. No significance claim; two held-out name families per eligible model.

predictions.restricted_additive_state: I=0 across frames at all positions
predictions.fixed_answer_label_writer: I=0 for Agent and Order, scalar coefficients -2 Theme/+2 Goal under Yes=+1/No=-1
predictions.constituent_sensitive_processing: May exhibit post-cue I at unchanged sites; query may change its later development. Presence alone is weak and nonlinear coding suffices.
predictions.generic_schedule: Cannot alone assign linguistic conditions; an input-conditioned depth schedule remains viable
predictions.strong_marker_position_copier: 64/64 draft gold labels; this pilot supplies no unique semantic-versus-copying discriminator

claims: Descriptive frame-conditioned permutation geometry only. No unique semantic mechanism, causal use, family-level law, population inference or novelty claim.
stop: One run per model, no resumed failed runs, no added prompts/models/patches, no post-output changes to code, thresholds, scoring, stimuli, sites or hypotheses. Report all exposed mistakes and missing held-out panels. Technical failures consume budget.
